_comment: IFR arrival via ABDI8R STAR — LFMN ILS 04L. Arrival-only: departure omitted because apply_field does not support transponder_code, so check_squawk_at_holding_point() cannot be satisfied from JSON. The departure half (LFLP SID ROMA2A, squawk, holding-point check-in) is exercised by ifr_lflp_departure_sim.json. This scenario covers the arrival half: ABDI8R STAR entry check-in → radar contact → STAR step-down simulation → Tower landing clearance → Ground handoff. Regular airport (Ground 121.750): runway vacated triggers Ground freq handoff (contrast: nostar scenario uses tower_only=true → taxi instruction). LFMN APP 120.025 / TWR 118.700 / GND 121.750.
name: IFR arrival — LFMN ABDI8R STAR, ILS 04L

1 — Nice Approach check-in at ABDI8R STAR entry (FL110). Expect radar contact.
